visualCharacteristics.purpose: boxed contact/payment tiles, each a short label over a handle or link (e.g. Zelle, Venmo, Instagram)

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile; cells: label | link (or one cell with a label paragraph and a link paragraph); external links open in a new tab

reuseGuidance: Use for small sets of text-only contact or social tiles with no images. For image cards use cards; for video cards use cards-video.
